Lightness value changed for .group-member-info .name in light theme
Lightness value changed for .group-member-info .name in light theme
findings.body: Same mistake as desktop/user.scss line 522: the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), and it was changed to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme color for group-member-info names is now 50% lighter than before instead of 30% lighter. Consequence: visual regression in the default (light) theme and inconsistent with the equivalent selector in desktop/user.scss before it was also broken in the same way.
